_comment: Lane W2 / Task #36 — Blood-resupply scenario for the 8-minute SPIRE demo. Six beats from H+0 (forward MLR posture, SATCOM degraded) through H+72 (resupply complete, audit lineage closed). This file is data, not code: edit narration, view focus, overlay text, or expected_duration_seconds_at_1x without an engineer. The scenario engine (lane A1) reads `beats[*].view`/`overlay` to drive the FE; the backend hook module (`backend/scenario_blood.py`) reads `beats[*].inject` to fire alerts/forecasts/audit entries at the right H+offset. Numbers cite sources inline so J3 can fact-check.
title: Class VIII (blood) resupply under SATCOM-degraded conditions
summary: 3d MLR forward at a contested first-island-chain objective takes a casualty event at H+12 that drives a Type O whole-blood and platelet demand spike. PULSE forecasts stockout at H+48 and recommends an air bridge from Kadena AB. SENTRY scrubs a releasable demand summary so the JSDF/ADF coalition cell can confirm the divert. BASTION shows the secured transit corridor at H+48; resupply lands at H+72.

beats.title: H+12 — Mass casualty event drives Class VIII demand spike

overlay.highlight: PULSE alert feed · Class VIII demand row
callouts: 14 casualties · est. 5 require massive-transfusion protocol
Demand surge: 40 O- RBC · 39 FFP · 5 PLT (above forward holding)
Forward LTOWB drawn first per JTS CPG

beats.narration: Casualty event. Fourteen patients arrive at the Role-1; about a third will need massive-transfusion protocol per the Joint Trauma System CPG. That's a one-to-one-to-one RBC, plasma, platelets at six units each, plus baseline for the rest. Demand jumps to roughly 40 O-negative red cells, 39 plasma, 5 platelets. We have four platelets forward. We're already in trouble on platelets — and platelets only keep five days, so there's no stockpile waiting.

inject.body: MTP-eligible: ~5 patients · est. demand 40 O- RBC / 39 FFP / 5 PLT. Forward holding insufficient on platelets and red cells. Stockout projected within 36 h without resupply.

beats.title: H+24 — PULSE forecasts H+48 stockout; recommends Kadena air bridge

overlay.highlight: PULSE Class-VIII stockout forecast · depot ranking · air-vs-surface mode decision
callouts: Stockout at H+48 if no resupply (≈24h horizon)
AIR · Kadena AB (720 nm, KC-130J ≈ 2h45m) — RECOMMENDED
AIR · Yokota AB (1620 nm, C-17 ≈ 4h10m) — backup if Kadena depleted
SURFACE · USNS Mercy CONREP (~36h transit) — INFEASIBLE: misses H+48 stockout window
Mode: AIR — air transit clears the stockout horizon by ≈45h; surface arrives ≈12h late

beats.narration: PULSE has the picture. At current burn the forward Class-Eight buffer goes to zero around H+48. Two air nodes are in range: Kadena Blood Support Det at 720 nautical miles — KC-130J makes that in two-and-three-quarter hours — and Yokota at 1,620, faster on a C-17 if we need the lift. We also looked at surface lift via USNS Mercy CONREP — that's roughly thirty-six hours before line-handlers, and we'd arrive about twelve hours after stockout, so PULSE rules surface out and recommends air. Of the two air options, Kadena: closer, smaller political footprint, and they hold 540 units of O-negative red cells plus 110 platelets.

inject.title: PULSE: Class VIII stockout projected at H+48
inject.body: Forward holding depletes at current MTP burn ~H+48. Mode decision: AIR (surface CONREP ~36h misses the window). Recommend air bridge from Kadena AB (720 nm; KC-130J 2h45m). Alternate air: Yokota AB (1620 nm; C-17 4h10m). Surface alt USNS Mercy CONREP — INFEASIBLE.

beats.title: H+36 — SENTRY scrubs releasable demand summary; coalition confirms divert

beats.narration: Coordination with the coalition cell. SENTRY takes the demand summary, classifies it, scrubs personally identifying numbers, weapon serials, and unit fault detail, and produces a REL TO JPN / AUS packet at the unclassified release ceiling. Australia's 9th Combat Service Support Battalion confirms KC-30A divert capacity. Japan's logistics liaison confirms airspace coordination from Kadena. The release event is in the audit chain — every redaction is auditable.

beats.narration: Mission accepted. BASTION renders the secured corridor — Kadena, transit south through the assigned air-control measures, escort cell on station for the 18-minute threat band crossing. Resupply lands at the forward MLR Role-1 around H+50:45. The clock keeps running, but the worst-case stockout is averted.

beats.narration: Resupply complete. Forward Class Eight is replenished — 30 units of low-titer whole blood, 40 O-negative red cells, 40 plasma, 6 platelets. PULSE updates: forward stocks now hold four-and-a-half days at projected burn. The audit chain shows the whole story — the casualty event, the forecast, the scrubbed coalition release, the mission acceptance, the close-out — every step hash-chained, every release auditable. That's the loop. Clear, decide, share, act, prove.

speed_validation._comment: Demo cadence has two modes. ACTUAL RUN: 1× clock with the scenario engine pausing between beats while narration plays — the 6 beats sum to 360s (6.0 min) of presenter time. REHEARSAL: the engine seeks beat-to-beat (clock jumps to each beat's offset, holds for `rehearsal_dwell_seconds_per_beat`, then jumps to the next), so a 6-beat dry run at 10s/beat = 60s. Continuous 16× playback (clock just runs) would take 4320/16 = 270 wall-seconds, which is too long for the <90s rehearsal target — that's why the engine implements seek-to-beat rather than rate-only fast-forward.
